mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.6 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1600.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers equity market risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 110.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential fixed investment signals strong aggregate demand, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation and federal funds rate signals a central bank response to persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150,000 jobs per month signals strong labor market demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal savings rate above 4.0% signals strong household financial resilience and pent-up demand, which increases the likelihood of future consumption and equity market optimism, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS exceeds 4.0%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
